subject: Insurance
title: Premiums, Deductibles, and Copays
description: A micro-lesson that makes Premiums, Deductibles, and Copays usable.

hook.text: Your premium keeps the policy active. Your deductible is what you pay before coverage starts. Copays split visit costs.

buildup.text: Low-premium plans have high deductibles—you pay more upfront. High-premium plans cover more from dollar one.

discovery.text: The average US family premium is $24,000 a year. Employers pay about 73% of that. Employees barely notice the full cost.

twist.text: High-deductible plans are growing fast. Average deductibles hit $1,700 for individuals.

climax.text: Health insurance has a hidden cost structure.

punchline.text: Premium opens the door, deductible blocks it. $1,700 before insurance pays.

quiz.question: What is a deductible?
options: The amount you pay before insurance starts covering costs
